scope: Current official-record and court routes for property-title-live

official_routes.purpose: Locate a registered property and identify its folio.
Obtain a plain or certified copy of a folio.
Obtain a folio with title plan/map.
Official searches concerning names, registered parcels/interests and specified register/map entries.
Search records concerning deeds/conveyances affecting unregistered property.
Applications or appeals to the Court under the Registration of Title Act 1964 and related registration directions.

important_limits: A map search identifies registration/folio information but does not by itself establish every legal interest.
A folio is evidence of registered title subject to statutory qualifications and the full legal record.
A title plan should not be presented as a universal determination of physical boundaries.
A Registry of Deeds search records the existence of deeds/conveyances; legal effect requires examination of the relevant documents.
A court route is procedural and does not itself determine the merits of an individual dispute.
remaining: Map each route to the exact current form/rule used by the website.
Verify current fees and any procedural changes immediately before publication.
Complete case-law review for propositions used in user-facing answers.
Complete amendment/commencement matrix for every relied-upon provision.
